import MilneLib.Sheaf.StableInvariantModuleSheafRestriction
import MilneLib.Sheaf.GaloisModuleSections
import MilneLib.Sheaf.QuasicoherentAffineOverlap

/-!
# Invariant sheaf comparisons from a geometric linearization

The sections, scalar actions and equivariance in the stable-affine comparison
are induced by the original sheaf and its linearization. Quasicoherence supplies
ordinary base change, so the associated invariant sheaves agree on affine
overlaps. This is a local input to the gluing in Milne III.1.13.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry
open MilneLib.GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction
open MilneLib.StableGroupAction.ModuleLinearization

namespace MilneLib.StableGroupAction.StableAffineOpen

variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
  [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
  {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.IsSeparated]
  {act : (L ≃ₐ[K] L) →* Aut X}
  (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))
  (hact : ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
    (act g).hom ≫ p = p ≫ (specAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L g).hom)
  {F : X.Modules} [F.IsQuasicoherent] (D : ModuleLinearization act F)
  (i j : StableAffineOpen act)

local notation "pK" => p ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))
local notation "hK" => galois_action_comp_base act p hact
local notation "R" => X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op i.U)
local notation "T" => X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op (i.U ⊓ j.U))
local notation "M" => F.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op i.U)
local notation "N" => F.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op (i.U ⊓ j.U))
local notation "A" => FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)
local notation "B" => FixedPoints.subalgebra K T (L ≃ₐ[K] L)

/-- The invariant sheaf on a stable affine chart restricts to the invariant
sheaf of the overlap sections. All semilinear data come from the linearization,
and ordinary base change follows from quasicoherence. -/
noncomputable def linearizedInvariantSheafOverlapIso :
    letI := sectionsAlgebra pK i.U
    letI := sectionsAlgebra pK (i.U ⊓ j.U)
    letI := sectionsAlgebra p i.U
    letI := sectionsAlgebra p (i.U ⊓ j.U)
    letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p i.U
    letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p (i.U ⊓ j.U)
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act i.stable
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act (overlap_stable act i j)
    letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact i.stable
    letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact (overlap_stable act i j)
    letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK i.stable
    letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK (overlap_stable act i j)
    letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction i.stable
    letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction (overlap_stable act i j)
    letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass i.stable
    letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass (overlap_stable act i j)
    letI : IsOpenImmersion (fixedSectionsRestrictionMap act pK hK i.stable
      (overlap_stable act i j) inf_le_left) :=
        overlapFixedRestrictionMap_isOpenImmersion act pK hK i j
    (tilde (ModuleCat.of A (invariantModule K L R M))).restrict
        (fixedSectionsRestrictionMap act pK hK i.stable
          (overlap_stable act i j) inf_le_left) ≅
      tilde (ModuleCat.of B (invariantModule K L T N)) := by
  letI := sectionsAlgebra pK i.U
  letI := sectionsAlgebra pK (i.U ⊓ j.U)
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p i.U
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p (i.U ⊓ j.U)
  letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p i.U
  letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p (i.U ⊓ j.U)
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act i.stable
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act (overlap_stable act i j)
  letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact i.stable
  letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact (overlap_stable act i j)
  letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK i.stable
  letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK (overlap_stable act i j)
  letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction i.stable
  letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction (overlap_stable act i j)
  letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass i.stable
  letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass (overlap_stable act i j)
  letI := moduleSectionsModule pK F i.U
  letI := moduleSectionsModule p F i.U
  letI := moduleSectionsModule pK F (i.U ⊓ j.U)
  letI := moduleSectionsModule p F (i.U ⊓ j.U)
  letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower pK F i.U
  letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower p F i.U
  letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower pK F (i.U ⊓ j.U)
  letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower p F (i.U ⊓ j.U)
  letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower_base K L F i.U p
  letI := moduleSections_isScalarTower_base K L F (i.U ⊓ j.U) p
  letI := overlapSectionsAlgebra act i j
  letI := overlapFixedSectionsAlgebra act p hact i j
  letI := overlapFixedSections_isScalarTower act p hact i j
  letI := sectionsRestrictionModule F (show i.U ⊓ j.U ≤ i.U from inf_le_left)
  letI : IsScalarTower R T N := IsScalarTower.of_compHom _ _ _
  letI : IsScalarTower A B N := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul
    intro a m
    rfl
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (fixedSectionsRestrictionMap act pK hK i.stable
    (overlap_stable act i j) inf_le_left) :=
      overlapFixedRestrictionMap_isOpenImmersion act pK hK i j
  exact invariantModuleTildeOverlapRestrictionIso act p hact i j M N
    (sectionsRestrictionLinearMap F inf_le_left)
    (D.sectionsRestrictionLinearMap_equivariant i.stable
      (overlap_stable act i j) inf_le_left)
    (quasicoherent_affineRestriction_moduleBaseChangeMap_bijective F
      i.affine (overlap_affine act i j) inf_le_left)

/-- On the actual quotient overlap open, the left chart's invariant sheaf is
the invariant sheaf of overlap sections transported from its affine spectrum.
This uses the same overlap presentation as the quotient scheme gluing. -/
noncomputable def linearizedInvariantSheafQuotientOverlapIso :
    letI := sectionsAlgebra pK i.U
    letI := sectionsAlgebra pK (i.U ⊓ j.U)
    letI := sectionsAlgebra p i.U
    letI := sectionsAlgebra p (i.U ⊓ j.U)
    letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p i.U
    letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p (i.U ⊓ j.U)
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act i.stable
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act (overlap_stable act i j)
    letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact i.stable
    letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact (overlap_stable act i j)
    letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK i.stable
    letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK (overlap_stable act i j)
    letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction i.stable
    letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction (overlap_stable act i j)
    letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass i.stable
    letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass (overlap_stable act i j)
    (tilde (ModuleCat.of A (invariantModule K L R M))).restrict
        (quotientOverlapι act pK hK i j) ≅
      (tilde (ModuleCat.of B (invariantModule K L T N))).restrict
        (fixedOverlapQuotientIso act pK hK i j).inv := by
  letI := sectionsAlgebra pK i.U
  letI := sectionsAlgebra pK (i.U ⊓ j.U)
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p i.U
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p (i.U ⊓ j.U)
  letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p i.U
  letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p (i.U ⊓ j.U)
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act i.stable
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act (overlap_stable act i j)
  letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact i.stable
  letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact (overlap_stable act i j)
  letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK i.stable
  letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK (overlap_stable act i j)
  letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction i.stable
  letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction (overlap_stable act i j)
  letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass i.stable
  letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass (overlap_stable act i j)
  let e := fixedOverlapQuotientIso act pK hK i j
  let f := fixedSectionsRestrictionMap act pK hK i.stable
    (overlap_stable act i j) inf_le_left
  letI : IsOpenImmersion f :=
    overlapFixedRestrictionMap_isOpenImmersion act pK hK i j
  have he : e.inv ≫ f = quotientOverlapι act pK hK i j := by
    have hf : e.hom ≫ quotientOverlapι act pK hK i j = f :=
      fixedOverlapQuotientIso_hom_comp_ι act pK hK i j
    exact (congrArg (e.inv ≫ ·) hf.symm).trans (e.inv_hom_id_assoc _)
  exact (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr he.symm).app _ ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp e.inv f).app _ ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.inv).mapIso
      (linearizedInvariantSheafOverlapIso p hact D i j)

/-- The invariant sheaves on two quotient charts agree along the actual
quotient transition. Both sides are compared with invariant sections of the
same original affine intersection. -/
noncomputable def linearizedInvariantSheafTransitionIso :
    letI := sectionsAlgebra pK i.U
    letI := sectionsAlgebra pK j.U
    letI := sectionsAlgebra p i.U
    letI := sectionsAlgebra p j.U
    letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p i.U
    letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p j.U
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act i.stable
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act j.stable
    letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact i.stable
    letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact j.stable
    letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK i.stable
    letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK j.stable
    letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction i.stable
    letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction j.stable
    letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass i.stable
    letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass j.stable
    (tilde (ModuleCat.of A (invariantModule K L R M))).restrict
        (quotientOverlapι act pK hK i j) ≅
      ((tilde (ModuleCat.of
        (FixedPoints.subalgebra K Γ(X, j.U) (L ≃ₐ[K] L))
        (invariantModule K L Γ(X, j.U) Γ(F, j.U)))).restrict
          (quotientOverlapι act pK hK j i)).restrict
        (quotientOverlapSwapIso act pK hK i j).hom := by
  letI := sectionsAlgebra pK i.U
  letI := sectionsAlgebra pK j.U
  letI := sectionsAlgebra pK (i.U ⊓ j.U)
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p i.U
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p j.U
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p (i.U ⊓ j.U)
  letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p i.U
  letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p j.U
  letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p (i.U ⊓ j.U)
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act i.stable
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act j.stable
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act (overlap_stable act i j)
  letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact i.stable
  letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact j.stable
  letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact (overlap_stable act i j)
  letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK i.stable
  letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK j.stable
  letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK (overlap_stable act i j)
  letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction i.stable
  letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction j.stable
  letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction (overlap_stable act i j)
  letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass i.stable
  letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass j.stable
  letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass (overlap_stable act i j)
  let C := FixedPoints.subalgebra K Γ(X, j.U) (L ≃ₐ[K] L)
  let Fj := tilde (ModuleCat.of (CommRingCat.of C)
    (invariantModule K L Γ(X, j.U) Γ(F, j.U)))
  let FT := tilde (ModuleCat.of (CommRingCat.of B) (invariantModule K L T N))
  let e := fixedOverlapQuotientIso act pK hK i j
  let s := (quotientOverlapSwapIso act pK hK i j).hom
  let qj := quotientOverlapι act pK hK j i
  let fR := fixedSectionsRestrictionMap act pK hK j.stable
    (overlap_stable act i j) inf_le_right
  letI : IsOpenImmersion fR :=
    overlapFixedRestrictionMapRight_isOpenImmersion act pK hK i j
  let cR : Fj.restrict fR ≅ FT := by
    let P (V : X.Opens) := ∀ (hV : IsStableOpen act V) (hVj : V ≤ j.U),
      letI := sectionsAlgebra pK V
      letI := sectionsAlgebra p V
      letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p V
      letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act hV
      letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact hV
      letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK hV
      letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction hV
      letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass hV
      ∀ (hg : IsOpenImmersion (fixedSectionsRestrictionMap act pK hK j.stable hV hVj)),
        letI := hg
        Fj.restrict (fixedSectionsRestrictionMap act pK hK j.stable hV hVj) ≅
          tilde (ModuleCat.of
            (CommRingCat.of (FixedPoints.subalgebra K Γ(X, V) (L ≃ₐ[K] L)))
            (invariantModule K L Γ(X, V) Γ(F, V)))
    have h : P (j.U ⊓ i.U) := by
      intro hV hVj hg
      exact linearizedInvariantSheafOverlapIso p hact D j i
    have h' : P (i.U ⊓ j.U) := (congrArg P (inf_comm j.U i.U)) ▸ h
    exact h' (overlap_stable act i j) inf_le_right inferInstance
  have hfR : e.hom ≫ s ≫ qj = fR := by
    have hswap := fixedOverlapQuotientIso_hom_comp_swap act pK hK i j
    have hright := fixedOverlapQuotientIsoRight_hom_comp_ι act pK hK i j
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
      ((congrArg (· ≫ qj) hswap).trans hright)
  have he : e.inv ≫ fR = s ≫ qj :=
    (congrArg (e.inv ≫ ·) hfR.symm).trans (e.inv_hom_id_assoc _)
  exact linearizedInvariantSheafQuotientOverlapIso p hact D i j ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.inv).mapIso cR.symm ≪≫
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp e.inv fR).app Fj).symm ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr he).app Fj ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp s qj).app Fj

end MilneLib.StableGroupAction.StableAffineOpen
